<a id="body"></a>

## Body

- C34: at most two review rounds; after round 2 only a normal-use correctness bug blocks (wrong result, data loss, stalled seat, cost breach). Say "final round" in the packet so seats grade that way; new round-2 findings become named follow-ups in Known limits.
- C33: same-user-only security findings are out of scope; rendering, caller derivation, contradiction refusals and external input stay in. Tell the security seats explicitly when a ruling changes grading (FYI to cold seats costs nothing).
- Wind-up: triage the F ledger (drop hardening, defer the rest), keep one reviewer, one security, one coder; retire the rest as each finishes: memory note first, release holdings, pij close, tmux kill-pane, then confirm pid and pane are gone (close alone never stops the process).
- pr-freeze: write its output to a file and check its own exit code; a piped `| tail && pij send` sent a READY on a failed freeze once. A transient "delivers running" fails it; rerun once.
- Assign coder/f<N> whenever a coder takes an F, or the Fixes: line has nothing to end; close finished requests with pij requests close --quiet, and answer requests with in_reply_to (native) or --in-reply-to.
- A reviewer that writes "queued next turn" on its card and ends its turn stalls; send one review at a time.
